identity.title: ALMA Resolves the Nuclear Disks of Arp 220

paper_type_evidence.quote: We present 90 mas (37 pc) resolution ALMA imaging of Arp 220 in the CO (1-0) line and continuum at λ = 2.6 mm.

evidence.quote: we adopt a luminosity distance D L = 87.9 Mpc and angular size distance D A = 85.0 Mpc (Armus et al. 2009)

question.value: What are the internal gas and dust distributions, kinematics and optical depths of the two nuclear disks of Arp 220 at 90 mas resolution?

evidence.quote: The internal gas distribution and kinematics of both galactic nuclei are well-resolved for the first time.
These ALMA Cycle 3 long baseline observations in CO (1-0) line were obtained in 2015 November for project #2015.1.00113.S.
The observations discussed here were in receiver Band 3

frequencies_and_spectral_setup.value: TDM, 4 spectral windows, 1875 MHz each, 1.95 MHz channels; centered at 113.253, 103.073, 101.139 GHz plus CO(1-0)

evidence.quote: Each window had a full bandwidth of 1875 MHz with 1.95 MHz resolution spectral channels.
One window was configured to observe the redshifted CO (1-0) line at rest frequency of 115.2712 GHz
The data were taken with 40 12 m antennas
The observations were done in a very extended configuration with baselines up to 11 km
